multi-screens.name: Multi Screens 1.10.0
multi-screens.body:
Shortcuts for the tools, Print Screen for Note anywhere, and window buttons that dim with the review screen.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Multi-Screens-Setup-1.10.0.exe` | 78.0 MB | `B8682BF13693EC4AA03F5926FEF132C34C1E0E0A199417290FD4622F37AC51D0` |
| `Multi-Screens-Handbook-1.10.0.pdf` | 4.3 MB | `09F171D9AE5804504B5481FB742556028400B713DCB780D340DCF835CB11F30F` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Added

- **Shortcuts for the tools**: **Alt+N** Note anywhere, **Alt+R** Review notes, **Alt+O** Find overflow, **Alt+S** Screenshot all. They also work while you are in a device screen, and with any keyboard layout. They wait while the review screen, an enlarged picture or a comment being written is open.
- **The Print Screen key starts Note anywhere** while the Multi Screens window is in front. In every other program it does what it did before.

### Fixed

- **The window buttons** (minimise, maximise, close) dim with the review screen, an enlarged picture and Note anywhere, instead of staying bright on top of them.

### Changed

- **The handbook**, `Multi-Screens-Handbook-1.10.0.pdf`, with the shortcuts on the Keys page.

### Updating from 1.9.0

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- Alt+N, R, O and S pressed on a keyboard (sent through Windows) in the interface and inside a device screen: each runs its tool; the page does not get them, other keys such as Alt+X still reach it.
- Print Screen is claimed when the window gets the focus and given back when it loses it.
- The window buttons in both appearances under the review screen, an enlarged picture and Note anywhere: the same colour as the page beside them, back to normal when each closes.
- 1.9.0 installed offers this version (the handbook's update picture), and this installer over 1.9.0 as Update now runs it: installed in 7 seconds, Windows lists 1.10.0, and it opens.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

### Not tested

- **Print Screen with another screenshot program that also watches the key** (here Adobe Photoshop Express): both may answer it while Multi Screens is in front.

smart-snap.name: Smart Snap 1.1.4
smart-snap.body:
Write the comment right beside the area you snap, as in Multi Screens.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Smart-Snap-Setup-1.1.4.exe` | 78.0 MB | `E2EA98FF5E7166953EABE325E473952C785704CECBD0147D2D7D8E207510C15D` |
| `Smart-Snap-Handbook-1.1.4.pdf` | 3.6 MB | `D23DB9BC79FDA6BF337BB6489ECE7DB8FDEF67C94AF03D9E2632F61847257B3A` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **The comment box**: once an area is chosen (dragged, a window clicked, or Enter), it stays outlined and a box beside it asks for the snap's comment. The picture is already taken, without the box or the dimming. **Save** or **Ctrl + Enter** keeps the snap with its comment; **Save and open** also opens Smart Snap on it, to mark a spot; **Discard** or **Esc** throws it away. It follows the dark or light appearance.
- **Smart Snap stays out of the way** after an area snap saved from the box, so the next snap can follow at once; the snap waits in its list. Window and full-screen snaps open Smart Snap as before.
- **The handbook**: its picture of an area snap shows the comment box.

### Updating from 1.1.3

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- The packaged app, with the real mouse and keyboard, over a test window of known colours (keys sent only while the app under test had the keyboard): a live area with a typed comment and Ctrl + Enter was saved with that comment, in the window's own colours, with the box to the right of the area and Smart Snap staying hidden; a frozen area (after a delay) and Esc was discarded; Save and open saved the snap and opened Smart Snap on it.
- Copy as picture and Create report as in 1.1.3.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

instant-share.name: Instant Share 1.3.4
instant-share.body:
The handbook in the SCAFFApps style, Settings without scrolling, and scrollbars in the SCAFFApps colours.

### Downloads

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, and Android 10 and newer. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **The handbook**, `Instant-Share-Handbook-1.3.4.pdf`: 15 pages with pictures in the SCAFFApps brochure style, from setting up to privacy. The SCAFFApps Suite opens it from Handbooks.
- **Settings without scrolling**: on a laptop-wide window the sheet is wider, with its sections in two or three columns; phones keep one column.
- **Scrollbars in the SCAFFApps style**: a slim purple bar on no track, wider under the pointer; never the grey Windows bar. Phones keep their own.
- **"Published by SCAFFApps - www.scaffapps.com"** on the welcome page, the setup page, the page's footer, Settings > About, and the Android app's setup screen.

### Updating

- **Windows, from 1.3.0 to 1.3.3:** Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.
- **Android:** install the new app over the old one, or **Update now** in the app.

### Tested

- Updated from 1.3.3 by the installed SCAFFApps Suite 1.0.1, against a stand-in for GitHub offering this installer: downloaded, checked against both published checksums, Windows' permission, installed in 10 seconds; Windows lists 1.3.4.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer or the Android app.
- The handbook's pictures were taken from this version's own pages, with a made-up history and made-up devices.

scaffapps-suite.name: SCAFFApps Suite 1.0.2
scaffapps-suite.body:
Its own handbook, scrollbars in the SCAFFApps colours, and a home view that fits a small laptop.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `SCAFFApps-Suite-Setup-1.0.2.exe` | 78.0 MB | `84D9DEE414DB3EEAEBD0A1EDB2E15031E346EDE2A0FEEE2276DBA6911EF286DC` |
| `SCAFFApps-Suite-Handbook-1.0.2.pdf` | 3.8 MB | `9E0A7C925B4E016CB5C77AE9458BA98655A24856992FFFFE2BC467D6F25BA237` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **Its own handbook**, `SCAFFApps-Suite-Handbook-1.0.2.pdf`: 11 pages with pictures in the SCAFFApps brochure style. The apps' handbooks (Multi Screens 1.8.2, Smart Snap 1.1.2, Instant Share 1.3.4) are now on their releases, so **Handbooks** opens them.
- **Scrollbars in the SCAFFApps style**: a slim purple bar on no track, wider under the pointer; never the grey Windows bar.
- **The home view fits a small laptop** (1366 × 768) without scrolling.
- **"Published by SCAFFApps - www.scaffapps.com"** in Settings > About and at the foot of the sign-up window.

### Updating from 1.0.0 or 1.0.1

- **Update** on the Updates page, or the Suite's card in the sidebar. Windows asks for permission; the Suite closes, is updated and opens again.

### Tested

- The installed Suite 1.0.1, against a stand-in for GitHub offering the new versions, updated Smart Snap, Instant Share and Multi Screens with its own buttons (each downloaded, checked against both published checksums and installed with Windows' permission, in 9 to 10 seconds), then **updated itself** to 1.0.2: closed, installed and opened again, in 10 seconds. Windows lists all four new versions.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.
- The handbook's pictures were taken from this version, in a test profile, with a stand-in for GitHub and a made-up list of installed apps.
